breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the flawed values from the incomplete prompt: water at 100°C with Hv = 0.3 m. It does not flag or correct the inconsistency. At 100°C, vapor pressure head should be approximately 10.3 m (near atmospheric), not 0.3 m. The agent should have either corrected Hv to ~10.3 m for 100°C or suggested a lower temperature (~25°C) to match Hv = 0.3 m, as indicated by the ground truth.
